+def arm_q(now):
+    """Convert interleaved joint_position proprio to the 14 arm-joint IK order."""
+    now = np.asarray(now, dtype=float)
+    return np.r_[now[:7], now[8:15]]
+
+
+def action_row(q14, now, r_open=None, l_open=None):
+    now = np.asarray(now, dtype=float)
+    row = np.empty(16, dtype=np.float32)
+    row[:7] = q14[:7]
+    row[7] = now[7] if r_open is None else r_open
+    row[8:15] = q14[7:]
+    row[15] = now[15] if l_open is None else l_open
+    return row
+
+
+def smooth_joint_move(robot, q14, duration=3.0, l_open=None, r_open=None,
+                      cameras=("ego", "wrist_left"), note="smooth IK move"):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=cameras, video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    start = action_row(arm_q(now), now)
+    goal = action_row(q14, now, r_open=r_open, l_open=l_open)
+    n = max(2, int(round(duration / 0.1)) + 1)
+    actions = np.linspace(start, goal, n, dtype=np.float32)
+    result = robot.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=0.1, video="mp4", note=note)
+    print("move", note, result.meta)
+    return result
+
+
+def move_tcp(robot, frame, xyz, quat=ORI_DOWN_CLOSE_Y, seed=None,
+             duration=3.0, l_open=None, r_open=None, note="TCP waypoint"):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    if seed is None:
+        seed = arm_q(now)
+    ik = robot.ik({frame: list(map(float, xyz)) + list(map(float, quat))}, seed=seed,
+                  tol_pos_m=0.004, tol_rot_rad=0.04)
+    print("IK", frame, xyz, ik.get("ok"), ik.get("error"))
+    if not ik.get("ok"):

+    E = np.asarray(obs.meta["cameras"][cam]["extrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
